messages:
elaine: Quick follow-up from PM postmortem INC-7203 — recurring auth-rate flapping caused repeated pages overnight (~90 in 2h). We need an owner-affinity dedupe + short mute windows.
miguel: Proposed: aggregate dedupe key = (error_signature, owner_affinity_tag). Owner_affinity = the team owning the service; ensure at least one page per owner group within 10m so responsibility isn't lost.
noah: Also add a 'sustained' detector: if rate > baseline * 4 for >5m OR distinct_hosts > 4 -> bypass mute and page immediately. Keeps noisy-but-real incidents from being hidden.
viv: I'll take the alert-routing middleware change and metric exports. ETA EOD Thu.
elaine: I'll own runbook updates and the postmortem action list. Target Monday for docs and validation checklist.
miguel: Implementation sketch (alertproxy):
```
key = hash(error_sig + owner_affinity)
if suppressed_recently(key):
  annotate(mute_reason)
  emit(metrics.alerts_suppressed{owner=owner_affinity})
  deliver = slack_only
else:
  deliver = pager
```
We should also sample suppressed events to a log stream for audits.
noah: Please emit alerts.suppressed.count and alerts.repaged.count with tags service, owner, region. I'll add a Grafana panel for suppressed vs paged ratio.
viv: Add a mute_reason annotation value like "deploy_noise" or "transient_socket" and a link to the PM ticket so oncall can inspect history quickly.
ops-bot: Reminder: oncall rotation this week — noah primary, viv secondary. Use /incident link INC-7203 for test pages.
elaine: Rollout plan: 1) unit tests + staging middleware (viv) 2) synthetic bursts across affected services (miguel) 3) 48h staging observation (elaine) 4) canary in us-west 24h → global. Revert criteria: repaged_after_suppression > 0.5% OR missed SLA alerts > 0.
miguel: Owners + ETAs: viv (middleware + metrics) ETA Thu, miguel (synthetic harness + dashboard panels) ETA Fri, elaine (runbook + 48h staging window) ETA Mon.
noah: I'll prepare the rollback playbook and a short checklist to attach to the postmortem ticket INC-7203 (include steps to disable suppression and force immediate paging). ETA Fri.
elaine: Action items summarized:
- viv: implement owner-affinity dedupe + export alerts.suppressed.count (due Thu)
- miguel: synthetic traffic harness + grafana panels (due Fri)
- elaine: runbook updates + 48h staging observation (due Mon)
- noah: rollback playbook + incident tags (due Fri)
We'll reconvene Mon 11:00 PT to review staging metrics and decide go/no-go.
viv: Posting PR to #eng-releases when ready :rocket:
ops-bot: Created task INC-ACT-1147 and assigned to viv, miguel, elaine, noah.
